mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_elder where del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from biz_elder where del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from biz_elder where del_flag = '0' and status = '2'
select count(*) from biz_bed where del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from biz_bed where del_flag = '0' and status = '1'
select count(*) from biz_room where del_flag = '0'
select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from biz_bill where del_flag = '0' and bill_month = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m')
select ifnull(sum(paid_amount), 0) from biz_bill where del_flag = '0' and bill_month = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m')
select ifnull(sum(amount - paid_amount), 0) from biz_bill where del_flag = '0' and pay_status = '0'
select count(*) from biz_bill where del_flag = '0' and pay_status = '0'
select count(*) from biz_bill where del_flag = '0' and pay_status != '1' and period_end < date_sub(curdate(), interval 30 day)
select ifnull(sum(amount - paid_amount), 0) from biz_bill where del_flag = '0' and pay_status != '1' and period_end < date_sub(curdate(), interval 30 day)
select count(*) from biz_visit where del_flag = '0' and visit_date = curdate() and status = '0'
select count(*) from biz_visit where del_flag = '0' and visit_date = curdate() and status in ('0', '1', '2')
select count(*) from biz_service_order where del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from biz_service_order where del_flag = '0' and status in ('0', '1')
select count(*) from biz_health_report where del_flag = '0' and status = '1' and risk_level = '2'

select date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m') as month, ifnull(sum(paid_amount), 0) as income, count(*) as billCount from biz_bill where del_flag = '0' and pay_status = '1' and pay_time is not null and date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m') >= #{startMonth} group by date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m')

select date_format(checkin_date, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as checkin from biz_elder where del_flag = '0' and checkin_date is not null and date_format(checkin_date, '%Y-%m') >= #{startMonth} group by date_format(checkin_date, '%Y-%m') order by month

select date_format(checkout_date, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as checkout from biz_checkout where del_flag = '0' and apply_status = '7' and checkout_date is not null and date_format(checkout_date, '%Y-%m') >= #{startMonth} group by date_format(checkout_date, '%Y-%m') order by month

select date_format(service_time, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as serviceDone from biz_service_order where del_flag = '0' and status = '2' and service_time is not null and date_format(service_time, '%Y-%m') >= #{startMonth} group by date_format(service_time, '%Y-%m') order by month
select ifnull(care_level, '') as careLevel, count(*) as value from biz_elder where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' group by care_level

select r.floor_no as floorNo, count(b.bed_id) as total, ifnull(sum(case when b.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as occupied from biz_bed b inner join biz_room r on b.room_id = r.room_id and r.del_flag = '0' where b.del_flag = '0' group by r.floor_no order by r.floor_no
select bill_type as billType, count(*) as value, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from biz_bill where del_flag = '0' group by bill_type
select item_name as name, count(*) as value, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from biz_service_order where del_flag = '0' and status = '2' group by item_name order by count(*) desc limit 5

select t.tenant_id as tenantId, t.tenant_name as tenantName, count(e.elder_id) as elderCount from sys_tenant t left join biz_elder e on e.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and e.del_flag = '0' and e.status = '0' where t.del_flag = '0' group by t.tenant_id, t.tenant_name order by t.tenant_id

select visit_id as visitId, visit_type as visitType, visitor_name as visitorName, visitor_phone as visitorPhone, elder_name as elderName, elder_id as elderId, date_format(visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as visitDate, visit_time as visitTime, people_count as peopleCount, status as status from biz_visit where del_flag = '0' and status in ('0', '1') and visit_date >= curdate() order by visit_date, visit_time limit #{limit}

select order_id as orderId, order_no as orderNo, elder_id as elderId, elder_name as elderName, item_name as itemName, nurse_name as nurseName, date_format(service_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as serviceTime, status as status from biz_service_order where del_flag = '0' and status in ('0', '1') order by service_time limit #{limit}

select bill_id as billId, bill_no as billNo, elder_id as elderId, elder_name as elderName, bill_month as billMonth, bill_type as billType, amount as amount, paid_amount as paidAmount, (amount - paid_amount) as unpaidAmount, pay_status as payStatus from biz_bill where del_flag = '0' and pay_status = '0' order by bill_month, amount desc limit #{limit}

select elder_id as elderId, elder_name as elderName, age as age, care_level as careLevel, gender as gender, date_format(checkin_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as checkinDate, phone as phone from biz_elder where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and care_level in ('3', '4') order by care_level desc, elder_id limit #{limit}
